svg.title: Suspended lattice — exact planar arrangement sculpture
svg.desc: 256 original cell regions and 128 original disk regions from one fully qualified planar arrangement. All vertical offsets are rendering displacements. Dotted links pair opposed uses of the same original graph edge; they are not modeled joins.

g.text: One exact plane. 128 circles. Every region, hole and opposed use retained.
